prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1398; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle shows a side impact to the driver-side rear quarter panel, with a crushed rear door, a cracked taillight lens, and scuffing along the rocker panel. Most of the damage lines up with the impact described at the intersection. Parts pricing and the paint blend on the adjacent panel look reasonable. The estimated labor hours run slightly high for a repair of this extent, so the shop should be asked to justify the time on the door reskin and the quarter panel alignment. The invoices show no duplicated charges. No prior damage to this vehicle is known. Recommended plan: replace the rear door, repair and refinish the quarter panel, install a new taillight assembly, and recheck the frame measurements before final payment.
